A1.justification: Both readable 38-page PDFs describe ReinFlow. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, checklist, and Appendices A–G support reliable comparison; no material reading gaps were found.

before.justification: v6 reports original simulated robotics experiments in Gym, Franka Kitchen, and Robomimic, including performance measurements and ablations in Sections 5–6 and Appendices E–F.

after.justification: v7 retains these original experiments, performance measurements, and ablations, including the appendix results.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithms 1–2 are unchanged, including learnable Gaussian noise injection, joint velocity/noise optimization, regularization, and removal of the noise network after fine-tuning.

E1.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix C retain the same Gym locomotion tasks, Kitchen complete/mixed/partial demonstrations, and Robomimic Can, Square, and Transport evaluations. No dataset, domain, or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: DPPO and FQL in the main state-based comparisons, Gaussian policies in Figure 3, and DIPO, IDQL, DQL, QSM, DRWR, and DAWR alongside DPPO in Figures 11–12.

E3.justification: The environment configurations, data processing, metrics, model sizes, training budgets, and evaluation procedures remain identical, including denoising and action-chunking settings documented in Appendices C–G.

E4.justification: The data-scale, denoising-step, time-sampling, noise-conditioning, noise-magnitude, and regularization analyses in Section 6 and Appendices E–F are retained unchanged. No ablation or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix E retains three seeds by default and five for Kitchen mixed/partial in the main experiments, with mean ± standard deviation shading. Table uncertainty reporting and the additional ablations' run counts are also unchanged.

E6.justification: All experimental curves and numerical entries are unchanged, including Tables 3–5 and Appendix F's ablations. For example, Table 4 retains the Hopper-v2 ReinFlow-R fine-tuned reward of 3205.33 ± 32.09 in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Theorem 4.1, likelihood and regularization derivations, and Appendix A's proofs and action-chunking analysis are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain identical scientific claims about novelty, stable fine-tuning, performance, and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: The interpretations in Section 6 and Appendix F are unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning sample efficiency, real-world adaptation, noise sensitivity, and scaling to large vision-language-action models.

D1.justification: Architectures, hyperparameters, hardware, timing procedures, and reproducibility instructions in Appendices D–G are unchanged. The documented code, model, and checkpoint access information is also unchanged.

R1.justification: The complete bibliography and research positioning in Section 2 and Appendix B are identical after accounting for page-break changes. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v7 shortens Tonghe Zhang's affiliation, changes Chao Yu's affiliation to Tsinghua's Shenzhen International Graduate School, and adds Beijing Zhongguancun Academy Project C20250301 to the acknowledgments. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Shorter affiliation blocks shift the abstract and introduction, while the expanded acknowledgment reflows references across pages 11–14. The version/date stamp changes. All figures and tables retain their design and placement, and all appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v7 updates affiliation and funding information with limited accompanying text reflow. The scientific exposition, methods, theory, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility material remain unchanged, so these administrative edits do not materially alter overall paper quality.
